why: **rclrs 0.7.0 CONVERGED ON OUR SHAPE.** 0.5.1 had one `create_timer`; 0.7.0 has `create_timer_inert` / `create_timer_oneshot` / `create_timer_repeating` -- the same three modes our `TimerMode` carries, arrived at independently. Same model, different placement -- so this is no longer the divergence the 0.5.1 comparison recorded, and W5 should consider matching the verb.
